req.title: OpenAPI includes task schemas
req.statement: The system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-040 requires that the OpenAPI spec (GET /openapi.json) documents TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas. Tests must verify: (1) positive — all three schema names appear in the spec components, (2) negative — the endpoint returns a valid JSON object (not 4xx), and (3) boundary — each schema contains the exact fields defined in schemas.py. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact schema names as strings, and exact field names within each schema to catch constant/name mutations.

tests.name: test_openapi_returns_200_and_contains_all_three_task_schemas
actions: Check that TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task are all present in components/schemas
trace: R-TASK-040: system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_returns_200_and_contains_all_three_task_schemas():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    assert "TaskCreate" in schemas
    assert "TaskUpdate" in schemas
    assert "Task" in schemas

test_openapi_returns_200_and_contains_all_three_task_schemas()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_schema_count_includes_exactly_three_task_schemas():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    required_names = {"TaskCreate", "TaskUpdate", "Task"}
    found = required_names & set(schemas.keys())
    assert len(found) == 3
    assert found == required_names
